title: Titan-Llama: Retrofitting Pre-trained LLMs with External Neural Memory Modules
abstract: arXiv:2610.19210v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformers are efficient to pre-train at scale because attention permits parallel computation across sequence positions, but long-context inference requires increasingly large KV caches. Efficient recurrent alternatives reduce the asymptotic complexity of inference, but their sequential dependence limits token-wise parallelism during training, making them harder to scale. Further, the current paradigm of extending long context tasks creates competing notions of retaining information precisely and keeping long-context inference efficient. To address this gap, we introduce Titan-Llama, a post-training method for retrofitting attention-based language models with a hierarchical memory architecture that updates parameters at test-time. Titan-Llama applies a blockwise attention mask and preserves full-fidelity attention over recent tokens while compressing historical context into recurrent, fixed-size neural memory modules (NMMs). translated_title: Titan-Llama：为预训练大语言模型加装外部神经记忆模块
translated_abstract: Transformer 之所以能够高效地大规模预训练，是因为注意力机制允许跨序列位置的并行计算，但长上下文推理需要越来越大的 KV 缓存。高效的循环类替代方案降低了推理的渐近复杂度，但其序列依赖性限制了训练时逐 token 的并行性，使其更难扩展。此外，当前扩展长上下文的范式造成了“精确保留信息”与“保持长上下文推理高效”这两种目标之间的冲突。为解决这一空白，我们提出了 Titan-Llama，这是一种后训练方法，为基于注意力的语言模型加装一种可在测试时更新参数的分层记忆架构。Titan-Llama 采用分块注意力掩码，在保持对近期 token 全保真注意力的同时，将历史上下文压缩进循环的、固定大小的神经记忆模块（NMM）中。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Titan-Llama 提出了一种后训练方法，为预训练的注意力型大语言模型加装可在测试时更新参数的分层神经记忆模块，在保留近期 token 全保真注意力的同时将历史上下文压缩为固定大小的记忆，从而兼顾长上下文推理的效率与信息保留精度。
en_tdlr: Titan-Llama is a post-training method that retrofits pre-trained attention-based LLMs with hierarchical neural memory modules updated at test time, preserving full-fidelity attention over recent tokens while compressing historical context into fixed-size memories for efficient long-context inference.
